findings.detail: The lower FcRn cup overlaps the schematic arm rather than clearly contacting Fc. The primary review locates the binding site at CH2/CH3. Clarify the native annotation with the source-figure owner; no atomic-geometry approval is granted.
The CDC target is clipped at the left source-canvas edge in both PNG themes. The complete canvas was viewed; this is not a tool crop.

Vanhersecke uses at least one CD23-positive cell with dendritic morphology within the TLS. The frozen inventory wording must not require a dense network, prominent germinal centre, or exclude an otherwise qualifying isolated dendritic cell.
Fc attenuation alone does not establish loss of target binding or absence of other toxicity mechanisms.
P33-RC01 is applied with reference-condition and estimate-uncertainty scope. Eight stale translated leads are withdrawn and one English simple entry corrected.
Crossref misspells cytotoxicity in the Clynes title; identifier, authors and year agree.
The Cabrita author correction changes funding wording, not the scoped biological or clinical results.

Of 58 explicitly attributable public-file hash assertions, 40 match at least one pin and 18 match neither. A further 63 structured/private assertions are not attributed to owner-file bytes or followed as private paths. An unmatched hash is not evidence of fabrication.
